notes: A roleplay hangout where the personalization is the outfit and nothing is owned is settlement-static by definition, so Morph Roleplay is the preset — the genre warns against assuming a plot, and the author confirmed there are no jobs, roles or houses, just hanging out and dressing up. I added path-street on top of the preset because the street is half of what the prompt actually asked for, and building-interior because the author said outright that players enter the main streetwear shops, which makes P3 a stated feature rather than an assumption; the answer also caps it, so only those shops are enterable and the rest stay facades. I left out path-road-vehicle since no vehicles were mentioned and the genre says not to apply 15- and 30-stud widths to a walking-only town. Downtown streetwear styling comes from the theme answer and bends the landmark and photo spots toward shopfronts rather than adding picks.
